params.caption: 🖥️ Nvidia board reportedly approached Arm CEO Rene Haas As Nvidia hunts for a new chief executive after Jensen Huang's exit, its board reportedly reached out to Rene Haas, who runs Arm and spent years at Nvidia before that.
